title: Common definitions
description: Shared scalar shapes (docs/design/m0/02). Spike simplifications, each stated: the schema checks the lexical form only; the checks named in each description belong to code.

Outcome.description: The four outcomes. There is no boolean ok.

ReasonCode.description: Lexical form of a reason code. Registration (schemas/vocab/reasons.yaml) is checked by internal/vocab, not here.

Time.description: Lexical form of RFC 3339 UTC with a Z suffix. Calendar validity is checked when parsed, not here.

TypeID.description: Lexical form of a TypeID: 2-3 letter prefix (note 05 uses rg_), underscore, 26-char base32 suffix. The UUIDv7 version and the entity-specific prefix are checked by the id package, not here.
